title: Curating Same-Family Neural Networks for LLM-Guided Model Improvement: A Controlled Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2607.05704v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Neural-network repositories contain executable models, recipes, input transformations, and measured accuracies. We study whether one same-family experiment can be curated as prompt guidance for LLM-based improvement of a low-performing target under equal generation and evaluation budgets. TuneNNGen extends NNGPT with a source-guided route and compares it with target-only generation on one CIFAR-10 target, two fixed source-selection rules, three code LLMs, and an additional SVHN target. Under the historical one-epoch search protocol, best-of-budget accuracy on the available evaluation split rises from 23.98% to 50.49% on CIFAR-10 and from 22.54% to 78.80% on SVHN. Selected five-epoch, three-seed means on train-derived validation splits retain gains of 40.94 points on CIFAR-10, 18.83 on Imagenette, and 7.27 on CIFAR-100. Direct-copy and negative-control analyses show that gains depend on source-target compatibility and LLM adaptation;

translated_title: 同族神经网络策展用于LLM引导模型改进：一项受控案例研究
translated_abstract: 神经网络仓库包含可执行模型、配方、输入变换和测量精度。我们研究在一个相等的生成和评估预算下，是否可以将一个同族实验策展为基于LLM的改进低性能目标的提示指导。TuneNNGen扩展了NNGPT，增加了一个源引导路径，并在一个CIFAR-10目标、两个固定源选择规则、三个代码LLM和一个额外的SVHN目标上，将其与仅目标生成进行了比较。在历史的一时代搜索协议下，可用评估分割上的最佳预算准确率在CIFAR-10上从23.98%提升至50.49%，在SVHN上从22.54%提升至78.80%。在训练派生验证分割上选定的五时代、三种子均值在CIFAR-10上保留了40.94个百分点的增益，在Imagenette上为18.83，在CIFAR-100上为7.27。直接复制和负对照分析表明，增益依赖于源-目标兼容性和LLM适应。
tldr: 通过策展同族神经网络实验作为提示指导，在相同预算下显著提升LLM引导的模型改进性能，且增益依赖于源-目标兼容性。
en_tdlr: Curating same-family neural network experiments as prompt guidance significantly improves LLM-guided model improvement under equal budgets, with gains depending on source-target compatibility.
